source_audit.interpretation: This is a full-edit packaging library. Independent kinetic text, compound clips, montage, masks, graphics, and sound cues carry more weight than continuous subtitles.

use_when: The user asks for 一创、高包装、爆款包装、混剪、人物故事、纪录感、综艺花字、信息图解、小红书感、Vlog包装, or a heavily designed edit.
A talking-head video needs more than a stable lower-third subtitle and should use semantic text hits, B-roll, compound cards, or sound-synchronized motion.
A reference edit should be reverse-engineered into transferable visual grammar instead of copied shot for shot.
do_not_use_when: The user only needs clean readable captions; use talking-head-industry-style-system.json instead.
The source has no safe visual space and the user has not authorized reframing, B-roll, or overlays.
Required native resources are unresolved; replace them with portable keyframes or omit them.
selection_order: Choose a visual_family from output intent, not industry alone.
Choose one base subtitle identity and one accent font family.
Mark the script beats: hook, setup, identity, conflict, data, method, turn, result, CTA or reflective ending.
Assign at most one primary text role to each beat.
Choose position from face, hand gesture, B-roll subject, and blank-space analysis.
Choose motion intensity and a matching sound family.
Build compound components only for relationships that need a card, diagram, comparison, timeline, or device UI.
Validate animation, effect, font, audio, media, and subdraft references before delivery.

documentary_news_explainer.use_when: Finance, current affairs, social observation, factual explanation, interviews, or B-roll-led narration.
documentary_news_explainer.grammar: Small stable white captions, restrained motion, high B-roll and compound-clip dependence.
documentary_news_explainer.avoid: Do not cover every sentence with a large keyword.

cinematic_person_story.use_when: 人物故事、情绪观点、关系议题、品牌纪录片、访谈金句或带余味的叙事。
cinematic_person_story.grammar: Break narration into short phrases, use serif or thin fonts, cream/coral accents, fade/typewriter/water-ink motion, and intentional negative space.

kinetic_viral_typography.use_when: High-retention opinions, editing education, beauty analysis, creator content, or rapid commercial storytelling.
kinetic_viral_typography.grammar: One phrase per beat, extreme size contrast, multiple screen zones, zoom/spring/slide/wipe motion, and sound hits.
kinetic_viral_typography.avoid: Do not run strong animation continuously; leave recovery beats.

data_infographic.use_when: Amounts, percentages, years, rankings, process stages, comparisons, or evidence.
data_infographic.grammar: Large number plus smaller unit, aligned rows, timelines, chapter numbers, and restrained supporting labels.
data_infographic.rule: Animate the relationship or change, not only the glyphs.

variety_reaction.use_when: Comedy, reaction, light education, tests, before/after, or deliberately playful edits.
variety_reaction.grammar: Rounded/cartoon fonts, outlines, reaction text, bounce/shake/wave motion, and dense sound punctuation.

lifestyle_xiaohongshu.use_when: Beauty, women's growth, health, lifestyle, self-improvement, or Xiaohongshu-like advice.
lifestyle_xiaohongshu.grammar: Warm and pastel palette, handwritten or rounded accents, large short keywords, elastic entrances, and intimate pacing.
lifestyle_xiaohongshu.avoid: Avoid finance-style hard yellow/red throughout the video.

tutorial_deconstruction_overlay.use_when: Internal learning, editing breakdown, asset replacement, font/effect notes, or implementation guidance.
tutorial_deconstruction_overlay.grammar: Instruction labels, source notes, effect names, replacement directions, and learning-only watermarks.
tutorial_deconstruction_overlay.export_rule: Exclude from audience-facing output unless the user explicitly asks for a tutorial overlay.

visual_montage_vlog.use_when: Vlog, visual transition piece, montage, mask-led sequence, or an abstract concept opener.
visual_montage_vlog.grammar: Minimal continuous text, heavy compound clips and masks, giant concept words only at chapter peaks.
visual_montage_vlog.rule: Let image structure carry the sequence; text is a chapter marker, not narration.

giant_concept_word.use_when: One conceptual chapter word in a visual montage.

typography_hierarchy.rule: Enlarge payload words only; keep connectors, units, and explanatory text smaller.

pairings.rule: Use sound on semantic transitions and strong visual hits; do not sonify every caption.

effect_catalog.rule: An effectStyle id inside content.styles is not enough. Create or reuse the matching materials.effects item and attach its fresh runtime id through extra_material_refs.

cinematic_phrase.use_when: A short person-story phrase, question, or emotional turn.

kinetic_keyword_hit.use_when: A viral result, amount, identity, or short conclusion.

data_question_card.use_when: Question, date, amount, or section label in a data-led explainer.

pastel_bounce_keyword.use_when: Health, beauty, lifestyle, or playful short conclusion.

xiaohongshu_red_hit.use_when: A short self-growth or lifestyle command/conclusion.

giant_concept_word.use_when: A single concept or chapter word in a montage.
giant_concept_word.limit: Use one word per chapter peak, not as continuous captions.

picture_coordination_rules: Analyze a representative frame before positioning text. Positive y is higher in this Jianying draft convention, but exact safe coordinates vary by aspect ratio and crop.
Keep continuous subtitles away from eyes, mouth, and active hand gestures.
Place independent keyword layers in the blank field opposite the subject whenever possible.
Use stroke, shadow, or a deliberate panel when background complexity changes during the text duration.
When a camera push or crop changes the blank field, split the text segment or keyframe its transform instead of accepting a collision.
Use foreground occlusion or masks only when the source composition supports stable separation; otherwise keep text entirely foreground or background.
Convert layouts semantically between horizontal and vertical canvases; do not scale absolute coordinates mechanically.
rhythm_rules: Use the first three seconds for one hook system: question, contradiction, proof, or visual mystery.
Keep base subtitles stable between designed hits.
Allow roughly 0.25-0.5 seconds for a strong text entrance, then hold long enough to read.
Do not place strong animations back to back without a visual recovery beat unless deliberately building a montage peak.
Use one-phrase-per-beat for kinetic families and complete clauses for documentary families.
End with one of four modes: CTA, summary, reflective quote, or visual hold. Do not add a CTA when the script has none.

branding_patterns: 一创让剪辑就是如此简单
exclusion_filters.rule: Keep reusable structure and numeric style grammar; discard source authorship, original wording, and tutorial-only layers.

implementation_rules: Treat every blueprint as a pattern, not a draft-ready fragment.
Resolve fonts locally and preserve font personality when substituting.
Generate fresh runtime IDs for every material, segment, effect, animation pack, keyframe, track, and subdraft reference.
For text effects, keep content.styles[*].effectStyle.id aligned with a matching materials.effects item and attach it through extra_material_refs.
For animation packs, copy resource metadata only after the local cache path resolves.
For audio, reuse an existing intentional local asset or request/generate a licensed replacement; do not depend on a missing source path.
Validate main and subdraft material references, then preview representative frames at the hook, first strong hit, data section, and ending.
